sermon.title: God's Words to Jesus 07/09/2017
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer shares his favorite scripture, Isaiah 49:6, where God tells Jesus that restoring Israel is too easy—he will also be a light to the nations and bring salvation to the ends of the earth. Tracing the falling away, times of refreshing, knowledge increasing and Israel born in a day, he argues God will yet manifest his power worldwide before Christ returns.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: Hawaii discovered 1778 and missionaries arriving 1820; “by 1680” total darkness; plague dates; literacy claims (Jews 100%, Middle Ages 5%); awakening dates (1732, 1790, 1856, 1948–1980); “50%” vs “10 to 15 percent” reading the Bible yearly; Jews “two percent Christians and 65 percent non-religious”; Israel’s 1948 founding by “the British and the United Nations”. Sensitive content kept as spoken: “any idiot can see”; popes’ homosexual acts and sex with women, nuns burying babies, Rome never repenting; “if you don’t have a Halley’s handbook … you’re just ignorant”; atheists, homosexuals and humanists “put to silence”; Hawaii missionaries chasing profit; a Florida revival with a female angel “a nightmare”; 1800s advent ministries “wrong.”

faqs.question: What has been his favorite scripture for 15 years?
faqs.answer: Isaiah 49:6, “it is too light a thing.”

faqs.question: What is salvation according to him?
faqs.answer: The work of God to deliver from sin and heal the body.

faqs.question: When does he say Hawaii was discovered?
In what order does God come?
faqs.answer: To his people, in his people, then for his people.

faqs.question: What comes before the second coming?
What books does he recommend?
faqs.answer: Halley’s Handbook and Foxe’s Book of Martyrs.

faqs.question: Until when must heaven receive Jesus?
faqs.answer: Until the times of restoration of all things.

faqs.question: Which nation was born in one day?
Can we know the time of his return?
faqs.answer: No, it’s not for us to know.
